name: Qilin
summary: Qilin (also tracked as Agenda) is the most active ransomware group by victim volume as of mid-2026, operating a mature RaaS platform with a resilient affiliate ecosystem. Following absorption of RansomHub infrastructure, victim disclosures increased approximately 280% over pre-absorption baselines. The group targets critical sectors globally and is notable for cross-platform encryptors targeting Windows, Linux ESXi, and Nutanix AHV.

ttps.notes: Compromised credentials primary initial access vector
Windows Subsystem for Linux used to run Linux ELF encryptors, bypassing EDR
Rust-dominant encryptor with intermittent/partial encryption for speed
Double extortion — data exfiltrated before encryption

detection_opportunities: Monitor for WSL process spawning encryptor binaries
Alert on PsExec execution outside maintenance windows
Detect registry run key modifications by non-standard processes
Monitor for bulk file encryption activity
Alert on VPN authentication anomalies and new device enrollment
